### Describe the Bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error

### Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

### Screenshots or Screen Recordings
If applicable, add screenshots or screen recordings to help explain your problem (please redact exact personal coordinates if sensitive).

### Environment Details
- **macOS Version**: [e.g. macOS 15.0 Sequoia, macOS 14.5 Sonoma, macOS 13.6 Ventura, macOS 12.7 Monterey]
- **Mac Model & Chip**: [e.g. MacBook Pro M3, Mac Studio M2 Max, Intel Mac mini]
- **App Version / Git Commit Hash**: [e.g. v1.0.0 or commit `a1b2c3d`]
- **Location Setting**: [e.g. Automatic Device Location or Manual City: Surat / Mumbai / London]
- **Widget Family Affected (if any)**: [e.g. None, SystemSmall, SystemMedium]

### Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here, such as relevant console logs from Console.app (`process == "ChoghadiyaMacApp"`).
